subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the Rann of Kutch is NOT correct?

options.text: This famous desert of white salt is visible after the monsoon season.
It is located in the Eastern Ghat in Odisha state.
It is famous for the wild ass.
It is a salt marsh in the Thar Desert in the Kutch District of Gujarat.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is located in the Eastern Ghat in Odisha state.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Rann of Kutch is located in the state of Gujarat, not Odisha.
 
• The Eastern Ghats are a mountain range in eastern India, stretching through Odisha, but the Rann of Kutch is not part of this range.
 
• The Rann of Kutch is a large area of salt marshes located in the Thar Desert in the Kutch District of Gujarat.
 
• This region is famous for its seasonal salt deserts and unique ecosystem, including the Indian wild ass.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographical Significance:**

 
 
• The Rann of Kutch spans an area of around 7,505 square kilometers.
 
• It remains submerged underwater during the monsoon season and transforms into a white salt desert after the water recedes.
 
 
 
• **Wildlife:**
 
 
• The region is home to the Indian wild ass (Equus hemionus khur), an endangered species.
 
• Other notable fauna include flamingos, pelicans, and various migratory birds.
 
 
 
• **Tourism:**
 
 
• The Rann Utsav, a cultural festival, is held annually from November to February.
 
• This festival showcases the cultural heritage of Gujarat and attracts tourists from around the world.
 
 
 
• **Historical and Cultural Importance:**
 
 
• The region has archaeological significance with sites dating back to the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• It is known for its traditional handicrafts, embroidery, and leatherwork created by local artisans.
